figures.assessment: Hydrogen oxidation versus time, four electron-acceptor series, with/without Bi-deferiprone. Assay controls/conditions are not a nanocrystal-preparation matrix.

Hydrogen oxidation bars for control and three Bi compounds. Caption identifies standard-deviation bars and says a no-Bi control was subtracted; displayed control bar/subtraction definition remains unresolved, replicate n unavailable. No bar endpoints digitized.

ATPase assay; vertical axis micromoles Pi released, whereas official caption last sentence describes H2 oxidation correction. Control, Bi citrate, Bi-deferiprone, Minus ATP and Heated protein. Error-bar meaning and n not supplied in this caption; Figure2 definition not transferred.

Bi2S3-labelled TEM/SAED, EDS and fringes; official caption assigns approximate [112] and [010] zone axes. Bi/S composition is not independent phase quantification. Cu attributed to support grid. Lower FFT insets meet/crop at image boundary; no unseen labels reconstructed.

Distinct Bi0-labelled TEM/SAED, EDS and fringes; caption approximate [001] and (120) contact-twin plane. This is not a bismuthinite product label. No phase fraction or treatment-to-image join inferred.

Fine particles versus hexagonal plate-like morphology with SAED inset. Scale bars20 and500nm; hexagonal external shape is not a hexagonal lattice. Cached text describes different centrifuged fractions.

Indexed XRD with several star-marked peaks, whose explanation is unavailable without full caption. Small labels are not fully rekeyed. Neither phase purity nor a competing phase assignment is inferred.
Bi4d/Bi4f/S2s XPS labels independently rekeyed:442,158.8,164.2,226eV. No peak-area composition or calibration correction inferred.
Three cyclic-voltammetry curves a/b/c; missing caption leaves curve identities, reference electrode, electrolyte, scan rate and normalization unresolved. No redox yield inferred.
Gel lanes1,2,3 and ten K-labelled ladder values. No accessible lane definitions, protein identity, purification proof or causal capping intervention.
Proposed biological-sulfide/protein-assisted synthesis scheme plus culture/TEM imagery; not a separate experiment or validated causal intervention.
